Show a rule with its recent runs; --toml prints it as a rule file

## Usage

```text
chainmail rule show <id|name> [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail rule show receipts --history
# save a rule as a file to edit
chainmail rule show receipts --toml > receipts.toml
```

## Flags

```text
      --history   also list the rule's revisions, newest first
      --toml      print the rule as a rule file, the shape rule create -f reads
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
